turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Welcome. I'm Aven, your health coach. What would you like to be called?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Priya. You're a little quiet, but it's fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Priya. What's been on your mind about stress lately?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Work, mostly. I've been lying awake running through my to-do list.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your to-do list follows you to bed.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Every night. I'd really like to be able to switch off.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What has helped you switch off in the past?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sorry, I have to go. My train is here.
